headlines.title: Prediction: Seagate’s Record Profitability Could Be Just the Beginning, 27% Upside Ahead
headlines.summary: Seagate just posted the most profitable quarter in its history, yet the stock has shed a quarter of its value in a month. What is the market missing, and how far could the gap between earnings and price close?

headlines.title: Seagate (STX) Stock Looks Undervalued Even With Rich Earnings Pricing
headlines.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings has delivered very strong long term gains for shareholders, yet the recent pullback raises a sharper question for you as an investor: how much of today’s share price is really supported by its current earnings power? Over the past 3 years, Seagate’s stock has returned a very large gain, which puts a lot of weight on whether its profit base can justify that kind of move.

headlines.title: 112% Upside for Seagate? Rosenblatt Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysRosenblatt Securities kept its Buy rating and $1,100 target on Seagate on Nov. 23.

headlines.title: Memory chip and neocloud stocks soar by double digits as investors decide they love the AI trade again
headlines.summary: Boosted in part by the return of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, companies including Micron, Sandisk, and CoreWeave are enjoying a Monday rally.

headlines.title: Investors Might Be Underestimating Seagate’s Long-Term AI Growth Opportunity
headlines.summary: Seagate's stock has already doubled this year, then slid hard in a single month. Wall Street still sees a path to far higher, and one number the CEO calls his North Star may explain why.

description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in providing data storage solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers External and internal hard drives; external and internal solid-state drives (SSDs); enterprise hard drives and SSDs; data storage systems; network attached storage (NAS) hard drives; video and analytics hard drives; and hyperscale and cloud solution. It offers its products for Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Surveillance & Security, and telecommunication industry. The company sells its products primarily to original equipment manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Singapore.
